Getting Started

This content is for v1.3. Switch to the latest version for up-to-date documentation.

ZenGrid renders only the rows you can see — a million-row dataset stays a handful of DOM nodes. This guide gets a grid on screen fast.

Install

Section titled “Install”
  • npm
  • pnpm
  • yarn
sh npm i @zengrid/core
sh pnpm add @zengrid/core
sh yarn add @zengrid/core

Your first grid

Section titled “Your first grid”

  1. Import the grid and its stylesheet.

  2. Create a grid against a mount element.

  3. Feed it data and render.
